note: Toolbar and menu action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor commands (e.g., New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, Print, Help)
Toolbar and menu view toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view modes (e.g., Sidebar, Statusbar, Fullscreen)
Toolbar and menu check boxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editor options (e.g., Word Wrap, Show Line Numbers, Highlight Current Line)
Toolbar and menu radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for exclusive options (e.g., View modes, Encoding selection)
Toolbar and menu labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for section headers or status indicators (e.g., 'Encoding', 'Line', 'Col')
